bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a special purpose credit loan program through Build Wealth MN.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+BUILD WEALTH MN; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for a grant to Build Wealth MN to expand and administer a special purpose credit loan program, a revolving loan pool used to provide affordable mortgage financing to underserved borrowers in communities of color. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a special purpose credit loan program through Build Wealth MN.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. BUILD WEALTH MN; APPROPRIATION.

$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for a grant to Build Wealth MN to expand and administer a special purpose credit loan program, a revolving loan pool used to provide affordable mortgage financing to underserved borrowers in communities of color. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $2,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for a grant to Build Wealth MN to expand and administer a special purpose credit loan program, a revolving loan pool used to provide affordable mortgage financing to underserved borrowers in communities of color. This is a onetime appropriation.
